campaign: EKF baro vertical-velocity pseudo-measurement, same-binary runtime A/B
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
purpose: During long GNSS outage the EKF vertical velocity is corrupted by tilt/bias (60 s trace: truth -1.91, EKF +0.76 m/s). Add an opt-in baro-altitude-slope v_d pseudo-measurement; A/B within one binary via --baro-vel-aid 0/1.
scenario: 30 m settled, 1 m/s target ramp, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 directions x 10 seeds; outage 43-48/63/103 s; A/B same binary with --baro-vel-aid 0/1

5s.note: aid inactive (age<8); the 20/60 absolute tail is a feature-binary layout-sensitive baseline, not an aid effect

verdict: Strong opt-in improvement for 20 s outages (touchdown tail 3.29 -> 1.09 m/s; drift median 530 -> 190 m; roll max 43.5 -> 31.2 deg). For 60 s outages it reduces touchdown median 3.35 -> 1.10 m/s but increases drift median 432 -> 545 m and p95 554 -> 1127 m (slower descent / longer exposure). Default remains off; enabling requires the macro (runtime default true) and real-flight validation.
caveats: Baro altitude is already used as a position measurement; the derived velocity is temporally correlated with it. The empirical result is positive but a joint position+velocity update or a dedicated vertical KF is theoretically cleaner.
Preliminary 10 Hz / sigma 0.5 m/s build looked worse (60 s touchdown median 3.91 m/s), but that was a different binary and is confounded by SIL layout; it is not used as causal evidence.

The feature binary's 5 s aid-off tail (20/60) differs from the older default-build 10/60; within the same binary aid on/off is bit-identical, so this is a SIL build-layout effect, not an aid effect. Embedded/real-flight validation is required.
SIL plant has no landing gear/impact model; touchdown speeds are kinematic.
All numbers are scalar-Eigen SIL L2, not real aircraft.

These A/B runs predate the final g_mode_degraded_gnss gate. Hover 20/60 s results were revalidated identically after the gate (baro-vel-aid-mode-gate-2026-10-26); flow-aided forward flight now has the aid disabled. Use the mode-gate meta for the final feature behavior.
